source.basis: Operator facility page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

reading.body:
Flexential Atlanta - Douglasville 1 publishes 22.5 MW of IT capacity across 205,000 square feet of technical space. At 40 kW per rack, a common AI training density, 22.5 MW supports roughly 562 racks; at 10 kW per rack, a more typical colocation density, the same load supports roughly 2,250 racks. The arithmetic is 22,500 kW divided by the assumed rack draw. Flexential does not publish a rack count, so neither figure is the operator's claim.

The six certifications qualify this campus for specific regulated workloads. SOC 2 Type 2 and SSAE 18 attest to audited operational controls. PCI DSS qualifies it for payment-card data environments. HITRUST qualifies it for healthcare information. ITAR qualifies it for controlled defense and export-restricted technical data. NIST 800-53 qualifies it for federal security control frameworks. Which tenants use any of these qualifications is not published.

Among the 33 Georgia facilities this site has mapped, only 4 publish a megawatt figure, and their combined published total is 66.3 MW. This campus, at 22.5 MW, ranks second among those four by published IT capacity, representing roughly 34 percent of the state's published total on this site. That share reflects the small number of facilities that publish usable figures, not a complete picture of Georgia's data center capacity.
